questions.q: How many eyes does a honeybee have?
questions.fact: Five! Bees have 2 big compound eyes on the sides of their head and 3 tiny simple eyes on top that help them sense light.

questions.q: What do bees mostly use to smell?
questions.fact: Their antennae! A bee's antennae are covered in tiny smell sensors, so she can sniff out flowers and tell hive-mates from strangers.

questions.q: Which kind of light can bees see that people can't?
questions.fact: Ultraviolet! Many flowers have hidden UV patterns, like landing strips, that point bees right to the nectar.

questions.q: Which color looks dark, almost black, to a honeybee?
questions.fact: Red! Bees can't see red very well, which is why they love blue, purple, and yellow flowers.
